name: MySystem
summary: MySystem is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers to identify trade entry and exit points. It systematically opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and employs stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk management. The EA is designed to run on medium to higher timeframes to capture sustained trend movements.
summary_zh: MySystem是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用移动平均线交叉来识别交易入场和出场点。它沿着当前趋势方向系统性地开仓，并使用止损和止盈水平进行风险管理。该EA设计在中高周期上运行以捕捉持续的趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于移动平均线交叉来判断趋势方向，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，下穿时做空。入场条件依赖于均线交叉信号的确立，通常要求收盘价确认交叉以减少假信号。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制以防止过度敞口，但没有采用复杂的动态仓位调整算法。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA relies on moving average crossover signals to determine trend direction, going long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and going short on the reverse crossover. Entry conditions depend on confirmation of the crossover signal, typically requiring a candle close to validate the cross and reduce false signals. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and positions may also be closed when an opposing crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a percentage-based calculation relative to account balance. Money management incorporates maximum position limits to prevent overexposure, but lacks sophisticated dynamic position sizing algorithms. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and well-suited for strongly trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy market conditions.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
具有明确的止损止盈设置，风险可控
趋势跟踪策略在单边行情中表现良好
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and optimize
Has defined stop-loss and take-profit levels providing controllable risk
Trend-following approach performs well in strong directional markets
cons: 均线交叉信号滞后，入场时机偏晚
震荡市场中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏自适应机制，参数在不同市场条件下需手动调整
cons_en: MA crossover signals are lagging, resulting in late entries
Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks adaptive mechanisms requiring manual parameter adjustment for different market conditions
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤指标（如ADX）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
引入动态止损机制（如追踪止损）以更好地保护利润
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter indicator (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Introduce a dynamic stop-loss mechanism (e.g., trailing stop) to better protect profits

risk_points: 均线交叉信号滞后可能导致较大回撤
缺乏市场状态识别机制，震荡市中风险增加
risk_points_en: Lagging MA crossover signals may result in significant drawdowns
Lacks market regime detection, increasing risk during ranging conditions

The EA is designed to run on medium to higher timeframes to capture sustained trend movements.
